lines.text: Commander, the squall during the sea crossing has swept some of our ships off course.
Our small detachment will have to march eastward alone. The Emperor has ordered us to proceed with all possible haste to the Wizard's Palace.
Sir Anston and the remainder of your forces can rejoin with us there.
We're under attack!
Commander, two small squads of fighters have been sighted in the surrounding forest...
How could they have learned of our arrival so quickly?
Those fighters were no match for us. Let us continue onwards.
Ambush!
Why are there so many hostiles this close to the Wizard's Palace?
Let's move east and not delay any longer on the cursed road.
Looks like someone is guarding the road up ahead.
I doubt they will let us pass without a fight.
Sir Varius, the road ahead is cleared.
We should make haste to the Wizard's Palace.
Our detachment has been destroyed!
Our western division is under attack! How would you have us assemble, Sir Varius?
Sir! Should we fight through to their catapults, or flank their front line and crush them between our combined forces?
The western front is secure, but the enemy has struck with their reserves at the heart of our battle line. The Emperor is in danger!
Your army has been destroyed!
Our eastern division has been completely shattered! Duke Pellus leads his vanguard at our Emperor! We must reach him before he is overrun!
Capture the boy alive if possible! Cut down the rest!
Duke Pellus has been defeated! Long live the Emperor!
Even as I fall, Merovin rises up against you. You will not sit long upon the throne, young Emperor.
The enemy is broken! We've won!
But not without cost. Who is your battle leader, soldier?
Your Imperial Majesty, that honor is held by Sir Varius.
Sir Varius. Carrone has lost much today, half of its army and much of its knighthood.
We would have you accept the title of Knight Banneret, bear your own sigil, and lead your own men to conquer the rebellion within our empire.
Succeed in this, and it will be our pleasure to reward you with land and title that befits your service to our cause.
The Emperor has fallen. All hope for the Empire is lost.
Merovin infantry approach along the river, supported by cavalry traveling the ridgeline.
Baron Valeuve means to test our strength, Commander.
The Baron's men are defeated and our scouts report the valley clear to the bridge keep ahead.
By your leave, I will send word to advance the army.
Your army has been destroyed!
The guard at the bridge keep has been reinforced, but our reserves have arrived as well.
How should we form our ranks, Sir Varius?
We have secured the bridge crossing!
Our rear guard has advanced and crosses even now to join the rest of your host.
Your army has been destroyed!
Baron Valeuve approaches to treat with you before the battle, Commander.
Sir Varius, I will not support this child of an Emperor nor will I yield my lands over to his rule.
Retire from the field now, or you leave me no choice but to cut your army to pieces.
I shall await your retreat from my battle line. Do not take long in your decision.
What is your command, Sir Varius?
Men of Valeuve, grant no quarter! Advance and destroy the enemy of Merovin!
Fight on, men! Do not lose heart! Drive them back to their Emperor!
I am forced to deliver my surrender. Valeuve is yours, Commander.
We have conquered the Barony of Valeuve! By the grace of the Emperor and for the glory of Carrone!
Your army has been destroyed!
Gather your men, sergeant! Hold them here for as long as possible!
East a half day's march sits Castle Corbeau, Commander.
Though it appears a peasant militia has been raised to resist our approach.
Numerous though they were, they could not hope to stop us.
We'll collect provisions from the village while our infantry advances, Commander.
Your army has been destroyed!
Commander, the enemy has dug a picket line and brought up musketeer and cannon support from the castle.
May the grace of the Emperor see us through this battle.
Militia advance! Keep them at cannon range!
We've broken through their line and captured their cannon!
Castle Corbeau sits just up the road, Commander.
Your army has been destroyed!
The town of Corbeau is just south of the castle, Commander.
It would make a strong rally point if we capture it before laying siege to the castle.
Fools! They may have taken the barbican, but they will break themselves upon the walls of my castle!
Yield! I yield! Grant me safe passage from Corbeau and the castle is yours!
The siege is over! They surrender!
Yield! I yield! Grant me safe passage from Corbeau and the castle is yours!
The siege is over! They surrender!
Your army has been destroyed!
Towns such as these cover the foothills of Bordavia and provide trade into the region.
This particular town is within the domain ruled by Count Valamir.
The town guard was expecting our arrival, Commander.
It is more than likely that count Valamir knows of us by now as well.
Your army has been destroyed!
Count Valamir's vanguard approaches from the east, Sir Varius!
Our full force has yet to arrive. We need more time!
Their vanguard has been shattered, but our scouts report the rest of Count Valamir's host waits for some reason.
By your leave, I shall carry orders to fortify the town in preparation for their assault.
Your army has been destroyed!
Count Valamir's army has arrived, Commander.
Wait... another battle group descends from the northern trail!
Bordavian mercenaries! Count Valamir hired a company of crossbowmen and delayed his attack until their arrival.
Wait... another battle group descends from the northern trail!
Count Valamir's army has arrived, Commander.
Men of Carrone. Bordavia is open to you no longer. Surrender this town and return to your own country...
or I will put each of your heads upon pikes as a warning to your kinsmen!
May the gods curse each day you spend within my country.
Their assault has broken itself upon our defenses, Commander.
Count Valamir was not found among the wounded. It is not clear if he lives still or if his body was carried from the battlefield by the few that were able to retreat.
Your army has been destroyed!
The main body of your army has yet to make their landing at Whitecliff, Commander.
His Grace, the Duke of Stokeshire, has put these men under your command as an honor guard to his castle.
AMBUSH!
Sir, our only chance of escape is across the river!
If we can't find a defendable front, they will overwhelm us!
We're losing men! If half of our number are lost, we'll not reach Stokeshire!
The men are dying, Sir Varius! Should we lose any more, we're done for!
We've lost too many men to have hope of reaching Stokeshire. We must turn back.
We've escaped their trap, but the enemy gathers for pursuit.
There is a ridge line ahead that should provide us with a better position to make a stand.
We've escaped their trap, but the enemy gathers for pursuit.
There is a ridge line ahead that should provide us with a better position to make a stand.
We've gained the high ground! They will pay dearly if they mount an assault upon this position.
From this height we might even be able to see Castle Stokeshire...
Smoke rising in the west! Castle Stokeshire is under attack!
We must finish these brigands quickly if we are to reach the castle in time to aid them.
The men are exhausted. We have no chance of reaching the castle.
I hope that we have not been delayed too long to aid Castle Stokeshire.
The men are exhausted. We have no chance of reaching the castle.
May devils take you, Martin! To think I once called you brother! Now I name you kinslayer!
Yield then! I have need of your lands, not your life.
And with these lands you would war against the Empire. Father would not have wished it, and so our lands came to me.
One of his greater follies, and his last.
Sir Varius! The castle is nearly done for!
If we are to save the Duke, we must rally his remaining men and strike at the attacker's siege engines!
Keep at it, lads! The bailey is ours and the keep is ripe to fall!
Where are those cursed trebuchets? That gate should be rubble by now!
I yield. Spare my men and the castle is yours, Martin.
Very good, brother. Now order your men to lay down their arms and surrender.
Men of Stokeshire! I have yielded the castle. Surrender and you will be spared.
The Duke's men have surrendered. Your army is lost.
RETREAT! Through the hunting gate and into the wood! Stokeshire must wait for now.
The attackers flee the castle! You have routed them, Commander!
Indeed. The situation was dire until your timely arrival. My thanks to you, Sir Varius.
It did not sit well with my brother Martin when our father's lands passed to me, nor my continued support of the Empire.
His army is broken, but his will is not. Martin will continue to rally support for the rebellion and strike where he is able.
Brother! I have captured your imperial envoy!
Open your gates and surrender, and I pledge both of you safe passage from Whitecliff to your beloved Empire.
Very well, Martin. Stay your blade and I shall open the gates to your men.
We have failed His Grace and the Emperor.
RETREAT! Through the hunting gate and into the wood! Stokeshire must wait for now.
The attackers flee the castle! You have routed them, Commander!
Indeed. The situation was dire until your timely arrival. My thanks to you, Sir Varius.
It did not sit well with my brother Martin when our father's lands passed to me, nor my continued support of the Empire.
His army is broken, but his will is not. Martin will continue to rally support for the rebellion and strike where he is able.
Brother! I have captured your imperial envoy!
Open your gates and surrender, and I pledge both of you safe passage from Whitecliff to your beloved Empire.
Very well, Martin. Stay your blade and I shall open the gates to your men.
We have failed His Grace and the Emperor.
Your army has been well provisioned by the Carrone camp and awaits your marching orders.
And the legion's general has arrived to discuss a battle strategy for conquering the pass.
You will no doubt recall Lord Anston, Viscount of Carrone and General of the Third Legion.
Sir Varius. I knew your worth would be recognized by the Emperor. It is good to see you again after so long.
If it were only under better circumstances. This campaign into Aguilleon will be hard fought and cost us many brave soldiers before it is done.
The legion will assist with war engines for the assault on the lower gate here, but their transport through the high pass will be most difficult.
It will fall upon your vanguard to clear the pass to El Acclazar if we are to support your siege of that great fortress.
I will make ready the legion and await your advance. May the Gods smile upon us, Sir Varius.
Conquer the gate as quickly as possible. The longer we fight here the more of their damned griffon riders will descend upon us.
Well done, Sir Varius. Lead the vanguard into the pass and the legion shall follow for the siege upon El Acclazar.
With the losses you have suffered, we must retreat and assemble a stronger force.
The Third Legion's war engines will take time to gain the summit of the pass.
If we should come under attack now, they would be especially vulnerable.
It will be up to your vanguard to shield them from danger. If too many war engines are lost, you will not have the strength to conquer El Acclazar.
Griffon Riders!
Encircle the war engines! Do not give them a clear line to strike!
A war engine has been lost! If we lose two more, continuing forward will be futile!
A second war engine destroyed! We can not afford to lose a third if we hope to siege El Acclazar!
Too many war engines have been destroyed. We must retreat to the Third Legion's camp.
Legion advance!
We have cleared the Aguilleon Pass!
What lies ahead will be your greatest challenge, Sir Varius. The conquest of El Acclazar.
Your army has been destroyed!
The war engines of the Third Legion are in position and reserve infantry will march forward after your advance.
Press forward on the road quickly, or your reserves will not have the room to deploy.
Our vanguard awaits your assembly orders, Commander. The men stand unafraid and will follow you to the very end. We will conquer El Acclazar.
Reserves advance!
Reserves advance!
Reserves advance!
All of the reserves are now committed to the field. Lead us to victory, Sir Varius.
El Acclazar has fallen! You have conquered where all others have failed! It is an honor to serve in your army, Commander.
The Carrone Empire owes you a great debt, Sir Varius. I shall see to it personally that the Emperor knows of your courage and prowess this day.
Sir Varius, we must retreat. With our losses, we cannot hope to conquer the fortress, much less hold it against any counter attack. El Acclazar must wait for another day.
This village is too close to our coastal shipyards and would be a natural launching point for Hunewold raids.
For this reason, this location also becomes ideal for the site of your fortress, Sir Varius.
The village tribe has gathered to repel us, rather than retreating into the wood as is their usual war strategy. Something has inspired them, even if their chance of victory is hopeless.
Spirits of their ancestors rise up to fight alongside their shamans!
It is as if we battle against armies of present and past!
The men are disquieted by the forest, Sir Varius, but I shall oversee its clearing at once for the fortress timbers.
By the Emperor's favor, we should have towers and ramparts raised before any reprisal can be mounted, if any is to come.
Your army has been destroyed!
Hunewold tribesmen approach from all sides, Sir Varius.
I have inspected the perimeter and found the towers and ramparts secure, though the moat is still incomplete for our high ground defense.
We should be able to repel any assault this rabble can muster.
Sir Varius. It appears that three different tribes are part of this attack.
Their advance is disorganized and they have little knowledge of formation, but the fact that they are cooperating is cause for concern.
The tribesmen host has broken and their survivors scatter into the wood to carry the tune of their defeat.
Your fortress is strong, Commander. Within the week, when the moat is complete and inner ring of towers raised, this position of strength will safeguard our coastal settlements from any harm.
Your army has been destroyed!
Sir Varius, I come with word just delivered from our far watch patrol.
A horde of Hunewold tribesmen, of a size greater than any met during the first conquest, has emerged from the east.
The tribes have united under a single war leader, Armagni, with the sole purpose of raiding and burning all imperial settlements in the Hunewold.
Their first hammer stroke will fall upon our fortress here. It will be up to us to turn the tide or be swept away under their onslaught.
By the gods! The very trees sway with the stamp of their approach!
My apologies, my lord. The men are ready and the fortress sound. Lead us through this terror to victory and the Hunewold is the Empire's once more.
Victory! VICTORY! Hail Varius, blessed be his name!
Sir Varius will be recorded in imperial history as the general that stood against the combined might of the Hunewold and tore it asunder.
This is a shining day for you and the Empire.
Your army has been destroyed!
You have the Emperor's trust and favor, Sir Varius.
The honor of leading the army that will first face the Horselords has been given to you.
As we march east and draw their fury upon us, Duke Stokeshire and Viscount Anston will land ships upon the Mirror Sea coast and retake our first settlement.
Attacking this small encampment will be the spark that ignites the Horselords' ire. We must keep them blind to our fleet if they are to land safely.
Setting fire to these huts will draw their scouts to investigate.
Word will spread among their tribes that Carrone has returned to the Rukiev. We should expect the Horselords' reprisal to be swift and fierce.
Your army has been destroyed!
Two days since our attack upon their camp and still no counter from the Horselords.
Their attention must be fixed upon us for our landing at the Mirror Sea to be successful.
Sir Varius! Horselords riding hard from the west!
REGROUP! They seek to strike at the rear flanks of our column!
The size of their force was smaller than expected. This could not have been their full strength.
Let us hope this was only a feint to test us. If their main host is not upon the plain when our fleet lands, our allies will be lost.
Your army has been destroyed!
The Horselords have arrived in strength, Sir Varius. Our scouts estimate they have nearly twice our number.
With still no messenger from our allies, we must assume that the fleet has been lost.
Our few against their many, we shall give them such a battle that will not long be forgotten.
We fight for Sir Varius! We fight for the Emperor! WE FIGHT FOR CARRONE!
Warhorns! Warhorns from the east!
By the grace of the Emperor...!
And for the glory of Carrone!
My Lord, your Grace, when no word arrived of your landing we feared the worst.
Our apologies to you, Sir Varius. Your attacks were successful in luring the Horselord host away from the Mirror Sea, but we were delayed in crossing Mare Nostra.
Aye, strange storm winds from the east nearly closed the narrows to us. Only a third of the fleet actually made the landing, we do not yet know the full extent of our losses.
There will be a time to mourn the dead. For now, let us celebrate the living.
Come, friends. Let us find a skin of wine to share while Sir Varius tells us of his campaign across the Rukiev!
Your army has been destroyed!
Commander, the squall during the sea crossing has swept some of our ships off course.
Our small detachment will have to march eastward alone. The Emperor has ordered us to proceed with all possible haste to the Wizard's Palace.
Sir Anston and the remainder of your forces can rejoin with us there.
We're under attack!
Commander, two small squads of fighters have been sighted in the surrounding forest...
How could they have learned of our arrival so quickly?
Those fighters were no match for us. Let us continue onwards.
Ambush!
Why are there so many hostiles this close to the Wizard's Palace?
Let's move east and not delay any longer on the cursed road.
Looks like someone is guarding the road up ahead.
I doubt they will let us pass without a fight.
Sir Varius, the road ahead is cleared.
We should make haste to the Wizard's Palace.
Our detachment has been destroyed!
Commander, look to the east - the Wizard's Palace is being assaulted!
They are unaware of our approach - we may be able to surprise them and take out their rear flank.
We'll need to fight our way through the warp portals on top of those dunes...
... to the south...
... and north.
The portals will warp us to the Palace interior. We should be safe inside the Wizard's Palace.
Commander, enemy reinforcements have arrived! We're severely overmatched - we must escape through the warp portals or we will surely perish!
Our numberse are dwindling, we need to reach those warp portals now!
If we lose another man, we will be overrun. This is our last chance to escape through the warp portals.
There are too few of us left. We were... so close...
At least one of us has made it safely inside the palace Commander.
At least... I think that's where he went...
Now let's get the rest of our detachment through the warp portals.
Excellent work Sir Varius, we've made it safely inside the Wizard's Palace!
Travelling by warp portal always leaves me with a queasy feeling. But it beats getting impaled!
Sir Varius you've arrived just in time! The Palace is under attack!
Enemy reinforcements sighted on the plains below Commander!
We can minimize our casualties if we stay out of range of their Horsebowmen.
Good news Commander, more of the Palace Guard has arrived just in time!
As friends to the Empire, we beseech you - help us man those Ballistae and defend our palace!
Commander, that warp portal will give us access to the battlefield below if you so choose.
Only a few enemies remain Commander. Let's move out and finish them off!
Oh no! The Palace Guard is taking casualties!
Sir Varius we need to secure the Palace before it's too late!
Varius, it has been an honor to witness your prowess as a battle commander.
We are indebted to you and the Empire for your help this day!
I don't understand it Commander, why would anyone be trying to attack the Wizard's Palace?
That's partially the reason you are here. Not only has the Wizard's Palace been coming under regular assaults as of late...
...we have received reports of violence and warfare from all corners of the eastern kingdoms.
Varius, we need your aid in discovering who or what is behind this chaos.
The Wizard's Palace has been protected for hundreds of years. How could we have failed to defend it?
Commander, these hilltop villages are under attack!
These must be the bandits the Wizards warned us about.
It's a good thing the lost ships carrying reinforcements were able to rejoin with us after the battle at the Wizard's Palace.
Yes, it is an honor to take the field of battle at your side once again Sir Varius.
Let's show these lawless bandits the wrath of the Empire!
That nearby warp portal should give us access to the southern hilltop.
Look there, bandits are attacking the villagers across the canyon!
Commander, more bandits have been sighted on the eastern hilltop!
Help us! We're being slaughtered!
Commander, this is terrible... these poor villagers are being wiped out! We must move quickly to rescue as many as possible.
The Innocent Villagers are being slaughtered Commander! If another dies, saving these villages will be pointless!
The villagers are safe for now. Their Craftsmen shouldn't have trouble repairing the damage caused by the bandits.
Sir Anston, take a look at this! One of the bandits was carrying a message...
...it reads as a directive for these bandits to join an attack on some city known as Caladrin.
Hmm... Caladrin is a large city not far from here.
Sir Varius, there's no way for us to know how long ago this message was sent...
We must hurry north and warn the good people of Caladrin before it's too late!
We've failed to protect these poor Innocent Villagers.
It is as I feared Varius. Caladrin has already sustained some damage from the assault.
Varius these villagers we rescued have agreed to join our cause. Among them are some talented Craftsmen.
It is my honor to serve the Emperor. Caladrin is home to many families, including my own - we should not delay!
These Craftsmen could be invaluable in assisting the repair efforts.
We must escort them safely inside the city.
Yeah, but how do we get there?
This desert is our domain. You are not welcome here.
Commander, those Dune Sirens are using their magic to create Quicksand!
I do not see an alternate route, we'll have to pass through it.
More of the cursed Dune Sirens ahead!
Two more portals ahead... but which one do we use?
Commander, one of the Craftsmen has been slain!
We must ensure that at least two Craftsmen reach the city interior to help repair the Caladrin defenses.
More enemies sighted! Someone doesn't want us to reach Caladrin.
Sir Varius, the Craftsmen have made it safely inside the city walls.
Our escort has failed. The city of Caladrin will have to defend itself.
Curses! I thought I had seen the last of you when I evaded capture in Sangsoleil.
Martin Landower?? What in blazes are you doing out here?
Just running an errand for someone. If you are as wise as I remember, you'll stay out of my way.
Do not be blinded by your own greed Landower!
Break off this assault and the Emperor may go lightly on you.
Haha! Greed no longer motivates me... only power!
If you want to help these people tell them to open the city gates!
Varius, I see you're determined to defend this city...
No matter, you've not seen the full power of the forces I command!
These Conjurers will have me inside Caladrin by nightfall whether you like it or not.
Bring down the walls men! Caladrin falls today! Bring the item to me when it is done.
Commander, Landower is fleeing the battle!
More of Landower's Forces have been sighted to the south...
...and to the northeast! Another of those blasted Conjurers is with them!
We must inform the Emperor and the Wizard's Palace that Martin Landower remains a threat!
...I wonder what he hoped to gain by attacking this peaceful city?
Commander, I have just learned from the city elders that Caladrin is the resting place of a secret treasure.
It appears to be some type of ancient scroll. I wonder what it says.
Varius, I shall send a messenger to the Wizard's Palace at once. I'd bet my last gold piece they can decipher this scroll's meaning.
Caladrin has fallen... Landower has humiliated the Empire.
From the top of this large dune we should be able to see most of the surrounding lands.
Ugh, these endless patrols in the desert have turned up no signs of Landower so far.
Marching through this sandy wasteland is not my idea of a pleasant afternoon.
If you had done as much scouting as you have complaining we might have found Landower by now.
Commander, what manner of creature is that? They look hungry.
Some type of giant desert leeches, I believe the locals call them 'Blood Gorgers'.
Commander, Landower has somehow tamed these Blood Gorgers so they will fight for him.
Let's cut down these foul beasts!
Commander, our Dune Sirens should be able to slow down their advance.
Perhaps we should deploy them down the hillside and get some Quicksand in front of those leeches.
Those Blood Gorgers are getting stronger as they feed.
Gurgle, Slurp, Gurgle.
...that's just disgusting.
Use your ranged attacks men!
Commander we should hurry to the top of the dune and secure a strong defensive position.
Sir Varius, more Blood Gorgers are coming up the dune.
...that was a bloody battle.
Those Blood Gorgers are nasty creatures. We should train some to fight on our side.
Sir Anston, do my eyes deceive me or is that a lake off in the distance there? Do you see it?
Ah yes, that must be the only water source for leagues in any direction.
...at least we'll be able to refill our canteens. Let's head to that oasis men!
Having my blood drained by a giant leech is not what I had in mind when I woke up this morning.
Boy is it ever warm out here!
Varius, there looks to be a lone Conjurer on top of that ridge.
What is he doing out here all alone?
Perhaps we can capture him and get some information on Landower?
Sir Varius, I fear we've walked into a trap.
Oh no! They've got us flanked!
Please grant reprieve. Knowledge to distribute. Landower's stronghold proximate.
One of the Conjurers has surrendered!
Varius, the Conjurer has revealed the location of Landower's base of operations.
He's at the oasis to the northeast. Be ready for war men!
Our lives have been... claimed by the desert.
Sir Varius, Landower's hideout stands before us.
Once we penetrate their defenses we should locate and capture Landower.
Welcome to my humble oasis. I must say, I'm flattered that you bothered to travel all this way.
You must be tired after such a journey. Why don't you join with me and you won't have to die in this wasteland?
In the name of His Imperial Majesty, surrender now Landower!
Give up, and I can promise you safe passage back to Carrone. The Emperor wants a word with you.
Ha ha ha! Very amusing Sir Anston, but I don't think I'll be surrendering just yet...
Varius, you cannot begin to imagine the powers you are dealing with!
They will not be as gentle with you as I have...
(gasp)...at least...I can die...with a sword in my hand.
Commander, Martin Landower and his forces have been defeated.
Hmm...I'm concerned about the meaning of Landower's dying words. It almost sounded as if he was part of some larger group.
We must send word to the Emperor right away!
Varius, one of Landower's messengers was slain during the battle.
He was found to be carrying some letters that indicate Landower was working with others in the Kingdoms of Tilicia and Isoluccia.
There are references in these letters to the "Battlemage" phenomenon the Archwizard mentioned...
Martin Landower has gotten the better of us.
Greetings, Sir Varius. It is good to see you safe and well through the Merovin Rebellion.
While you wage war to recover the lost kingdoms of the Empire, I have been given the honor of rebuilding the Third Carrone Legion.
Your assistance in training the recruits is greatly appreciated. Grant me but a moment to address the men before we begin.
Men of Carrone! Today you will learn to fight as soldiers of the Third Legion!
The path to victory lies in gaining advantage over your enemy. Each army's strength has its counter strategy!

A large force of foot troops will be powerful, but they are slow to maneuver and vulnerable to ranged attack! Cavalry will be quick and devastating in the charge, but will break upon a reinforced pikewall!
In facing a reinforced position, such as this fortress, war engines are critical in bringing down the walls or gate!
The defender will likely be in position to strike first, so a tight formation of armored soldiers will be needed to shield your advancing army!
Sir Varius, I will take command of the defending force. Rest assured my crossbowmen will give your army a warm welcome.
I take pride knowing that I trained you as squire. Your skill in battle will return the Empire to its former glory!
You are a worthy adversary, Sir Varius. Any further assistance in training the Legion would be met with my deepest gratitude.
Greetings, Sir Varius. It is good to see you safe and well through the Merovin Rebellion.

Your assistance in training the recruits is greatly appreciated. Grant me but a moment to address the men before we begin.
Men of Carrone! Today you will learn to fight as soldiers of the Third Legion!
The path to victory lies in gaining advantage over your enemy. Each army's strength has its counter strategy!

A large force of foot troops will be powerful, but they are slow to maneuver and vulnerable to ranged attack! Cavalry will be quick and devastating in the charge, but will break upon a reinforced pikewall!
In defending a reinforced position, such as this fortress, use ranged attacks from the shelter of towers or ramparts to weaken the approaching army!
Rotating wounded units from the front line to heal in interior buildings is also vital to maintaining a strong defense force!
Sir Varius, I will take command of the attacking force. Beware my war engines, for they will turn your fortress to rubble before long.
I take pride knowing that I trained you as squire. Your skill in battle will return the Empire to its former glory!
You are a worthy adversary, Sir Varius. Any further assistance in training the Legion would be met with my deepest gratitude.
